pages.text: $(term)Entropy$() is a property of the scroll that measures its instability. During scroll alchemy, guessing the essence of each slot may accumulate entropy on the scroll.

pages.title: Entropy Table
pages.text: $(li)Double restraint / being doubly restrained: +2.$(li)Restraint / being restrained / mutual restraint / symbiosis: +1.$(li)Neutral / matching (annihilation): +0.$(br2)The lower-left of the scroll interface describes its current stability.

pages.title: The Price of Guessing
pages.text: The higher the entropy, the more scroll durability each later annihilation consumes, and the fewer outputs the scroll can produce. Brute-force guessing is costly; infer the target from each state change with as few attempts as possible.

pages.title: One-Time Recipes
pages.text: Some recipes are $(term)one-time$(): after a successful production, the scroll in the catalyst slot vanishes regardless of how much durability it has left.
